integrity_notes: A self-contained analytical proof supports an exact all-length three-mode transition and a sufficient threshold for any fixed band dimension. The included standalone standard-library code is supplementary numerical verification, not an infinite certificate. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: D-optimal determinant volume, not the smallest singular value or condition number; only consecutive-time one-sensor sampling on normalized paths and contiguous lowest spectral modes. The all-mode sufficient path-size bound is not known sharp. The detailed finite-path section of the motivating preprint was inaccessible after the introduction and abstract were inspected; priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Low-pass dynamical frame-volume transition on normalized paths
